title: CanaryResult
description: Result of evaluating one canary fixture against one engine. SINGLE artifact for both canary kinds, discriminated by `mode` (decision Q3, approved 2026-08-20). The common envelope is identical in both modes so that a reader can index, compare and hash results without branching; only `payload` differs. NEW schema; nothing here modifies an existing sieve schema.

mode.description: Discriminator. 'exact': the engine is asserted to reproduce a byte-identical canonicalized output. 'semantic': the engine is asserted to satisfy declared invariants and to land inside declared tolerances, without byte identity.

fixture.description: Which fixture was evaluated. fixture_version is separate from fixture_digest on purpose: the version is the human contract, the digest is what actually ran.

engine.description: Engine identity under test. Required in BOTH modes: a canary result without an identified subject cannot be filed against anything.

run_ref.description: The run this canary was attached to, if any. Reference + digest only.

stats_vector.description: Required in BOTH modes. The ordered, versioned summary of the run, computed from the COMMON SURFACE ONLY (ext.* excluded by construction). Order and element identity are fixed by stats_vector_spec; `values` is positional and MUST have the same length and order as the spec's elements.

verdict.description: Classification, not a grade. MATCH: every declared assertion held. MISMATCH: at least one declared assertion did not hold. UNVERIFIABLE: a precondition could not be evaluated (B5 audit-time classification) — distinct from MISMATCH, which is a statement about the engine. PENDING_GENERATION: the fixture has no expected value yet; the result records what was observed so the expectation can be minted from it after review.

Sha256Hex.description: Lowercase hex sha256. Fixed by the contract; there is no algorithm field.

ExactPayload.description: Exact mode. Precondition: the three-layer hash agreement (input / effective config / environment fingerprint). Assertion: canonicalized output digest AND stats_vector digest both equal their expected values.

precondition.description: THREE-LAYER HASH AGREEMENT. Each layer is a classification, not a boolean, so that 'could not be computed' is never silently folded into 'did not match'.

expected.description: Expected digests. Both members are null exactly when the fixture is at status pending_generation; in that case verdict MUST be PENDING_GENERATION. A placeholder digest is forbidden.

SemanticPayload.description: Semantic mode. Precondition is EVIDENCE, not an assertion: either the two sides share a behavior_config_hash (same engine, different environment), or a per-field common-surface comparison table is referenced (different engines). Assertions are the declared invariants plus tolerance-bearing statistics.

oneOf.description: Different engines. The comparison table is a per-field statement about the COMMON SURFACE (ext.* excluded). It is referenced by digest so the assertion cannot drift from the table it rests on.

kind.description: conservation: a quantity identity that must close exactly. two_sided_equality: each trade's two legs agree in quantity. no_crossing: the book does not cross. sign_domain: prices/quantities lie in their declared domain. event_count: a structural count. statistic_tolerance: a stats_vector element inside a declared tolerance.

tolerance.description: Absent means the assertion is exact (tolerance zero by construction, e.g. a conservation identity over integers).

basis.description: WHERE THE NUMBER CAME FROM. numerical: floating-point/summation-order error only. seed_variation: spread across seeds of the same configuration. structural: exact by construction. provisional: not yet derived from either — must be replaced before the tolerance can carry a claim.
